_comment: Per-DEVELOPER overrides for the pr-walkthrough skill. Copy to .guardian/pr-walkthrough.local.json. NOT committed — it falls under the project's .guardian/* ignore rule. Shallow-merged over the committed pr-walkthrough.config.json, so any field from that file can be overridden here; these two are the ones that usually should be.
_notesPath: Where running review notes are kept. Null (or absent) uses the session scratchpad.
_recordDestination: Where to offer to file the finished review record — your notes vault, a local directory, wherever you keep them. Absent means the skill will not guess: it leaves the record in the scratchpad and asks.
